### Harvard in Tech is at an important turning point

We are a volunteer-led alumni community that has grown into a global network of founders, technologists, operators, investors, and professionals.
momentumSections.title: Why Support Harvard in Tech?

description: The recognition wall on the real /donate page, promoted to the top by an editor changing its Order field — which is the control Nicole asked about in the same round of feedback, and the reason the wall is a momentumSections entry rather than hardcoded composition. It also shows the wall in real page context, grouped by giving level with Founding badges across the levels, an anonymous donor among the named, and a donor whose tier the page no longer declares collected under Other supporters instead of dropped. Its default position, between the member quotes and the closing ask, is what the committed content ships.
